mapper.sql: application.id, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_job_application sequence_application WHERE sequence_application.document_srl = application.document_srl AND ( sequence_application.applied_at < application.applied_at OR ( sequence_application.applied_at = application.applied_at AND sequence_application.id <= application.id ) ) ) AS application_number, application.document_srl, application.applicant_name, application.gender_code, application.birth_date, application.age_text, application.job_text, application.organization_text, application.mobile_phone_enc, application.mobile_phone_masked, application.tel_phone_enc, application.tel_phone_masked, application.region_text, application.address_enc, application.address_masked, application.extra_comment, application.prior_research_text, application.email_address_enc, application.email_address_masked, application.notify_email_yn, application.notify_sms_yn, application.notify_keyword_yn, application.application_status, application.is_new_applicant, application.is_blacklisted, application.black_mode_applied, application.provide_yn, application.delivery_status, application.delivered_at, application.delivery_job_id, application.applied_at, application.updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM admin_job_application application ORDER BY application.applied_at DESC, application.id DESC

SELECT
FROM admin_job_application application WHERE application.document_srl = #{documentSrl} ORDER BY application.applied_at DESC, application.id DESC
SELECT document_srl, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM admin_job_application GROUP BY document_srl ORDER BY document_srl DESC

SELECT answer.field_id, field.field_key, field.field_label, field.field_type, field.field_order, answer.answer_text, answer.answer_json FROM admin_form_submission_answer answer INNER JOIN admin_form_field field ON field.id = answer.field_id WHERE answer.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY field.field_order ASC, answer.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_job_application SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_job_application SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, is_blacklisted = 'Y', black_mode_applied = #{blackModeApplied}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE admin_job_application application SET application_status = #{applicationStatus}, is_blacklisted = 'N', black_mode_applied = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application.is_blacklisted = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_blacklist_match_log match_log WHERE match_log.application_id = application.id AND match_log.blacklist_id = #{blacklistId} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM admin_blacklist_match_log other_match_log INNER JOIN admin_blacklist other_blacklist ON other_blacklist.id = other_match_log.blacklist_id WHERE other_match_log.application_id = application.id AND other_match_log.blacklist_id <> #{blacklistId} AND other_blacklist.active_yn = 'Y' AND (other_blacklist.expires_at IS NULL OR other_blacklist.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
